answer: Physical Presence Grove. Each identity must maintain a continuously powered node whose radio observes a local delta in ambient signal noise, witnessed by neighboring nodes. A node claiming many identities must supply that many independent physical locations with distinct noise signatures; colocated fakes collapse into one cluster. Registering an extra identity costs a separate site, power feed, and radio hardware — roughly the price of a small server per identity, plus the pearl of renting each site's observable uniqueness.
